question: In a code language, SHIFT is written as VKLIW and LIFT is written as OLIW. How will JOB be written as in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SHIFT is written as VKLIW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6ebd9a68167ca7a5b28f0f3d65a9b0eb18a1ee887d79f6e2875c38e2c51dde.png] 

And,

LIFT is written as OLIW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91b341e90b0eea140d1b2520fed8972e6db0d87a185d8b95e08ebe0a7ed1d19d.png] 

Similarly,

JOB will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fd04ee963c49b061ef6ab22eecfbc305246a7efdcc73aa9c953b89e568d2ea7.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
